label: High-Resolution Digitization Station
description: A combination of LIDAR and multi-angle photography used to create 'Digital Twins' of specimens for remote research.

components.function: Captures sub-millimeter surface geometry using projected light patterns.
Rotates the specimen 360° while a camera takes hundreds of high-resolution photos.
Uploads the 3D mesh to a global repository (e.g., MorphoSource) for other researchers.

game_mechanics.archival_speedrun: The museum only gives the player 4 hours of 'Collections Access.' They must scan as many specimens as possible before the doors lock.
game_mechanics.digital_pathology: Using the scan to highlight 'Combat Scars' or 'Healed Fractures' that are invisible to the naked eye.
